entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: English playwright and poet (1564–1616), widely regarded as the greatest writer in the English language. His 37 plays and 154 sonnets explore the full range of human experience and profoundly shaped English literature, language, and theater.
